name: Living City
description: An engraved waterfront instrument, listening to real water and wind measurements from Tampa Bay.

assets.credit: Original mechanical estuary engraving · Tampa Curated

compatibility: Modern Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge with SVG, Fetch, ES modules and IntersectionObserver. No WebGL or runtime dependencies.
Touch, keyboard and mouse operate native controls. The detailed drawing scrolls horizontally on narrow screens; readings remain in readable HTML.
Reduced motion holds still poses and disables replay animation. Hidden or offscreen studies stop animation and polling. Simulation works offline.

Live observations require access to NOAA HTTPS endpoints. Independent product errors, stale timestamps, missing values and optional local cache are visible. The static plate does not claim live readings.
notes: An original scientific instrument with an engraved waterfront, water wheels, linked float and counterweight, pulleys, small architecture, wind turbine and compass. The drawing is imaginative, not a map of the station.

Old Port Tampa (8726607) is the default. St. Petersburg (8726520) is an alternative. Official NOAA CO-OPS products provide water level, wind and six-minute tide predictions. Water is metres above MLLW; wind is m/s from true north.

Water height lifts the float; its fixed-length rope moves the counterweight in the opposite direction. Wind direction turns the compass; wind speed drives the turbine. Predicted tidal slope drives the linked wheel and tide instrument, not an invented water-current measurement.

The live and simulation modes are always labeled. Sensitivity and response controls alter drawing units only. Observations retain their actual values, original UTC timestamps, preliminary/verified status and quality flags.

Recent observations can be replayed forward or backward at a chosen time scale. Missing intervals remain unavailable. The drawing eases between records; displayed observations are not interpolated. Predicted tide is linearly sampled between six-minute predictions.

Observation responses are cached for six minutes, tide predictions for an hour. Errors are per product. Cached readings retain their original timestamps; readings older than 30 minutes are marked stale. Refresh is limited to once per 30 seconds.
reuse: Download and serve the source ZIP over local HTTP. Open example.html: it includes this complete instrument, controls, simulation presets and independent NOAA adapter. No Tampa modules or API key are required.
Use mount(host, settings, report, adapter) for the complete experiment. Supply your own normalized sensor adapter without changing the drawing.
Use createNoaaAdapter, sampleSensors, targetMechanics and createDrawing separately. The adapter contract, units, cache, quality semantics and lifecycle are documented in README.md.
Export the selected readings as JSON or save the current drawing as SVG. The Lab settings preset and source ZIP preserve the selected settings. Call dispose before removing the host.
